findings.issue: Digit-by-digit machine reading: ２０歳 transcribed as にれいさい ('two-zero'), a reading no native uses. Correct is にじゅっさい (or はたち). Romaji 'nireisai' needs the same fix.
findings.current: かのじょわにれいさいといってもつうようする。
findings.suggested: かのじょわにじゅっさいといってもつうようする。

findings.issue: Token ２０ (before counter 歳) has reading にれい; 二十歳 is read にじゅっさい/にじっさい (or はたち as a unit), never にれいさい.
Token list starts with two stray tokens お and 金 before 彼女, duplicating the real お金 token that appears correctly mid-sentence; concatenated surfaces yield お金彼女は… ≠ jp. Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1].
findings.current: s:'お' + s:'金' inserted before 彼女
findings.suggested: Remove the two stray leading tokens; keep the single お金 token in sentence position

findings.issue: Literal mirror invents a verb 'took' (no 取る in JP) and recasts the relative clause その時持っていた (modifying お金) as a coordinated action, misteaching the structure the field exists to show.
findings.current: She, at that time, took all the money she had, and gave it to him.
findings.suggested: She, all the money (she) was holding at that time, gave to him.

findings.issue: 〜てきた (生きてきた) mirrored as 'vir-vivendo fez' — 'fez' corresponds to nothing in the JP (きた = 'veio'); the phrase is ungrammatical PT and misleads about the auxiliary's meaning.
findings.current: Ela, aqueles-tais tempos, finalmente vir-vivendo fez (até aqui).
findings.suggested: Ela, aqueles-tais tempos, finalmente veio vivendo (até aqui).

findings.issue: Relative clause flattened into a main clause: 'naquele tempo possuía todo o dinheiro, a ele deu' reads as two coordinated statements; 持っていた should stay a modifier of お金 in the mirror.
findings.current: Ela, naquele tempo possuía todo o dinheiro, a ele deu.
findings.suggested: Ela, todo o dinheiro que naquele momento possuía, a ele deu.
